Settle in at your own pace and choose a recording that feels comfortable today. Every soundscape has its own rhythm, and you are welcome to change your mind before beginning this listening break.

Before starting, make sure you are somewhere you can rest without needing to watch for moving traffic, equipment, or other demands on your attention. Keep the volume comfortable enough to notice your surroundings, and stop the break whenever you need to.

A listening break is simply an invitation to pause. There is no score to achieve, no timer you must complete, and no need to keep a particular pace. Your choice belongs to this local session, and this panel does not begin audio playback.

A warm room beside the old library fireplace — Low crackles, a little movement in the room, and quiet intervals between them. The recording was made from an armchair a comfortable distance from the fire.
